title: Characterization of real weak values for qunits
statement:
Let $|\varphi_0\rangle$ and $|\psi_0\rangle$ be distinct, nonorthogonal unit vectors in $\mathbb{C}^n$. Let $\\{ |\varphi_0\rangle, |\varphi_1\rangle, \dots, |\varphi_{n-1}\rangle \\}$ and $\\{ |\psi_0\rangle, |\psi_1\rangle, \dots, |\psi_{n-1}\rangle \\}$ be orthonormal bases containing the respective vectors. Define

$$
\mathcal{P}_\varphi=\left\\{ |\varphi_k\rangle\langle\varphi_k|-\frac{1}{n}\mathbb{I}:0\leq k\leq n-1\right\\},
$$

and define $\mathcal{P}_\psi$ likewise. Let $\mathcal{S}$ be the trace-zero subspace of the Hermitian matrices, and let

$$
\mathcal{R}_{\varphi,\psi}=\operatorname{Span}_{\mathcal{S}}\\{\mathcal{P}_\varphi,\mathcal{P}_\psi\\}.
$$

For $M\in\mathcal{S}$, write $\mathcal{W}_{\varphi_i,\psi_j}(M)$ for the weak value associated with the pre- and postselected states $|\varphi_i\rangle$ and $|\psi_j\rangle$. **Real weak-value characterization conjecture.** For all $i,j\in\\{0,1,\dots,n-1\\}$,

$$
\mathcal{W}_{\varphi_i,\psi_j}(M)\in\mathbb{R}
$$

if and only if $M\in\mathcal{R}_{\varphi,\psi}$.

For $n=2$, the space $\mathcal{R}_{\varphi,\psi}$ is the PPS plane, and the preceding proposition establishes the forward inclusion. The conjecture seeks the converse characterization in higher dimensions $n>2$, where determining when weak values are entirely real is described as highly nontrivial and remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.02113

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2015).
source_name: J. M. Farinholt, A. Ghazarians and J. E. Troupe, “The Geometry of Qubit Weak Values”, arXiv:1512.02113 (2015).
